title: From finish to fit, in four steps
body: A simple, transparent path from choosing your plate to it landing on your bike.

steps.title: Choose your style
steps.description: Compare finishes across our five plate styles — hand crafted, 2D printed, Crystal 3D™ and Black 4D — and pick the one that suits your bike.

steps.title: Personalise the details
steps.description: Enter your registration and choose the options available for your chosen product, with a live front and rear preview updating as you go.
points: Borders, flag, logo, slogan and fixings

steps.title: Review and order
steps.description: Check your design, add your delivery details and complete your order. Road-legal plates include document verification where required.

steps.title: Made and dispatched
steps.description: Your plate is produced to your saved specification and dispatched. Track it to your door — ready to fit and ride.
